title: Nomination
description: One row of the Academy's record: one nomination (or one honorary/technical award) at one ceremony in one category. Fields other than 'id' may be omitted when the request narrows them with fields=.

source_line.description: Line number of this row in data/oscars.csv and in the audit report (always id + 1).

winner.description: This row won. A ceremony x category group can have several winners (ties, multi-award classes); see group.winners.

official.description: False when the Academy notes this was not an official nomination. Independent of winner: 8 unofficial rows are winners.

credit_line.description: The Academy's credit prose, verbatim (source column Name).

detail.description: Role, song title or technical field, verbatim (source column Detail). May contain '|' separators aligned to titles.

corrected.description: True when the 2026-09-24 audit changed at least one source cell of this row. embed=corrections lists the changes.

group.description: Counts for this nomination's ceremony x canonical-category group. No tie flag is derived: several winners can be a tie or a multi-award class.

imdb_ids.description: Every IMDb ID this row references, de-duplicated, in credit order.

titles.description: embed=titles. The films this row is for, in credit order. A slot with no known IMDb ID keeps its text and position.

credits.description: embed=credits. The named nominees, in credit order, as the Academy credits them.

corrections.description: embed=corrections. Audit changes to this row's source cells.

as_credited.description: The title as the Academy credits it (e.g. a US release title).

title.description: Canonical title of imdb_id; null when the slot has no ID.

detail.description: The role or song for this title, when the source aligns one detail per title.

as_credited.description: The name as credited (pseudonyms and birth names kept).

identities.description: Who the credit denotes: usually one entity, sometimes several (a shared pseudonym), empty when no IMDb ID is known. Never inferred by position from a neighbouring slot.
